newsitem.title: CANADA: Cabre says Egypt well driving its stock.
newsitem.headline: Cabre says Egypt well driving its stock.

text.p: Cabre Exploration Ltd said on Thursday that brisk trading in its stock could be due to speculation about its wildcat oil well in Egypt.
Cabre has a 50 percent stake in the Rabeh-1 well in Egypt's West Esh El Mallaha concession, which began drilling on May 13 and is now at 6,000 feet, Cabre said.
"Oil and gas shows were encountered during drilling, but no log, cores or tests have been conducted to determine what significance these shows may have," the company said.
The well, operated by Naftex Energy Corp, was to be drilled to total depth in the next few days, logged and, if warranted, tested, Cabre said.
Cabre stock closed unchanged on Thursday at 23.50 on volume of 313,056 shares.
The company's shares began a sharp rise on Tuesday and have risen from 19.50 in mid-April. ((Reuters Calgary Bureau (403) 531-1624))
